headline:
Your tax bill grew
[[twice as fast]]
as everything else
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
takeaway: Broward's tax levy: 100.3 percent. Population and inflation combined: 44.0 percent.

stats.label: Broward's property tax levy grew 100.3 percent from 2014 to 2024.
Population and inflation combined grew just 44.0 percent in the same decade.
Broward ranks 27th of 67 Florida counties for that gap.
